sites.rationale: GPR85 has no signal peptide (topology string contains no 'S'; residues 1–24 are extracellular per landmarks), so M1 is the true mature N-terminus and the only extracellular terminus of the receptor. The N-terminal FLAG tag in pcDNA3.1-N-DYK places the tag before M1, giving insert_after_residue = 0 by topology derivation. The 24-residue extracellular N-terminal stretch (residues 1–24) provides ample clearance from TM1 (which begins at residue 25). Surface display of an N-terminal FLAG tag on the close SREB-family paralog GPR27 was explicitly confirmed by anti-FLAG-HRP detection in non-permeabilized HEK293T cells (L1), and N-terminal FLAG tagging of GPR85 itself is further corroborated by L3 and L4 (pcDEF3-FLAG constructs used in expression studies). Full-length human GPR85 was cloned into pcDNA3.1-N-DYK vector, which places a FLAG (DYK) tag at the N-terminus of the receptor; the forward primer (5'-CCTAGGTACCATGGCGAACTATAGCC-3') encodes GPR85 starting at M1, confirmed by sequence match (MANYSH). The construct was used alongside cAMP (pGloSensor-22F), CRE-luciferase (pGL4.29), and SRE-luciferase (pGL4.33) reporter assays in HEK293T cells.

literature_notes: Five ledger lines were evaluated. L2, L3, and L4 all directly report N-terminal FLAG tagging of full-length GPR85; L2 was chosen as the primary clip because it is the most explicit description of the cloning strategy (pcDNA3.1-N-DYK, forward primer anchored at M1). L1 (GPR27/SREB1 paralog) provides the only explicit surface-display confirmation for an N-terminal FLAG tag in the SREB family (anti-FLAG-HRP in non-permeabilized cells), strengthening confidence that the GPR85 N-terminal tag reaches the cell surface. L5 (GPR27 C-terminal BioID2-HA) was not used as a surface site because the C-terminus of GPR27 — like GPR85 — is intracellular. The C-terminal myc-His construct from L3 is recorded in other_positions as intracellular. No ledger line supports an insertion in any of the three short extracellular loops (ECL1: 79–95, ECL2: 159–183, ECL3: 307–320), so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length GPR85 was subcloned into pcDNA4/TO/myc-His, appending a myc-His tag after the C-terminal residue I370; the C-terminus (residues 342–370) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface site.
